stemMd: A company announces that its training programme has no drawbacks because its internal newsletter has printed only favorable comments about it. Which overlooked possibility most undermines the reasoning?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Some employees read the newsletter online.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The newsletter may have selected favorable comments while omitting critical ones.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The company offers more than one programme.

explanationMd: Published comments are a selected sample. Unless the selection process preserves critical as well as favorable views, uniformly positive publication does not establish uniformly positive experience or an absence of drawbacks.

distractorRationale.b: Reading medium does not establish comment representativeness.
distractorRationale.e: Other programmes do not establish this one's drawbacks.
distractorRationale.d: Length is not the key evidential limitation.
distractorRationale.a: Frequency does not by itself identify a biased selection.
